items.question: In the UAE, can businesses obtain financing products that comply with Islamic Shari'a banking guidelines?
items.gold: Yes, financial products that comply with Islamic Shari'a banking guidelines can be obtained from banks.
items.fact: UAE banks offer Shari'a-compliant business financing products

items.question: When advertising your business in the UAE, do some forms of advertising require coordination and approval from government entities?
items.gold: Yes, some forms of advertising require coordination and approval of the government entities concerned.
items.fact: Some UAE advertising forms need government entity approval
